correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the standard C2 natural spline second-derivative equation and exact area identity, derived all normalized weights, established central positivity and disjoint outer negativity intervals, proved uniformity of the random ratio by explicit order-statistic Jacobian, solved the norm inequality exactly, and proved moment divergence by the 1/T singularity and Tonelli. Symbolic identities and 360 exact rational area comparisons passed. No finite testing substitutes for the analytic all-parameter proof.

value.rationale: Three knots are the first nontrivial knot count for natural-cubic integrals; two knots give a positive affine average. For the first possible failure, the exact probability, all-threshold robustness distribution, and infinite expected absolute-noise error quantify a real risk of random unconstrained spline integration. Unlike a bare illustrative counterexample, the exact distribution is a natural complete invariant of the method under uniform random sampling.
